forum.title: Clarification on Recommending a π Coupling Filter Placed Before the Matching Circuit
tags: ST25 Dynamic NFC Tags – ST25DV series
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

The ST25DV04K is an old product which is in NRND (not recommended for new design). I would suggest that you go with the ST25DV04KC which is active.

The Discovery kit is : [ST25DV64KC-DISCO | Product - STMicroelectronics](https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/st25dv64kc-disco.html)

Despite that the kit uses the ST25DV64KC, it has the exact same functionalities as the ST25DV04KC (with more memory). Hence you can use this kit to evaluate the ST25DV04KC functionalities.

Best regards
forum.content_text:
Dear ST Support Team,

We are currently developing a board based on the ST25DV04K and would appreciate your guidance regarding the antenna interface.

In our schematic, we have placed a π coupling filter (series inductors and shunt capacitors) between the AC0/AC1 pins and the antenna matching circuit, upstream of the latter, for coupling at 13.56 MHz, as shown in the attached schematic.

Could you please clarify whether the use of this π coupling filter, positioned before the matching circuit, is **recommended** by ST, or whether it is not necessary in this configuration?

Thank you in advance for your support — we look forward to your recommendations.

Best regards,

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/66c9d698-84ac-4782-9478-507202ee32ed.png)

scraped_replies.html:
Dear ST Support,

I am designing a PCB using the ST25DV04K and would like to know whether the Pi filter on AC0 and AC1 is mandatory or optional.

Can it be removed if the antenna matching network is properly designed, or is it recommended for EMC/RF performance?

Thank you for your clarification.

Best regards,
scraped_replies.author: ARIJ

scraped_replies.html:
Hello, 

No, this pi filter is not recommended, you can remove it.

C704 should be used only to fine tune the antenna in case you designed it at a too high frequency, but I recommend designing the antenna at the right tuning frequency and not populate C704 unless a re-tunning is required.

C703 and C705 can be populated if you find some EMC issues but are usually not necessary.

Best regards.
scraped_replies.author: JL. Lebon

scraped_replies.html:
Hello,

Thank you for your clarification. That answers my question regarding the PI filter.

I have one more request. Would it be possible to share the Altium PCB design files (schematic and PCB) of the ST25DV04K evaluation board? Having access to the original design would help me better understand the layout recommendations and antenna implementation.

If the Altium project cannot be shared, any available PCB design files or layout documentation would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you in advance for your support.

Best regards,
scraped_replies.author: ARIJ
